name: bio-steward
description: See the Bio-STEWARD check verdict, results and rule explanations of a computational-biology repository inside VS Code. Uses the steward CLI you installed.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Bio-STEWARD runs the steward CLI on the repository's files. In Restricted Mode it runs nothing; trust the workspace to run checks.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Bio-STEWARD runs the steward CLI as a local process, which virtual workspaces (vscode.dev, github.dev) cannot do.

bioSteward.cliPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path of the `steward` program to use. Empty: look on `PATH`, then in the pipx and uv tool folders. A workspace cannot set this, and a repository-local `.venv` is never picked automatically.

bioSteward.gate.markdownDescription: The gate whose eligibility the status bar shows.

bioSteward.check.onSave.markdownDescription: Run `steward check` again after a file is saved (debounced, one run at a time).

markdownEnumDescriptions: `.steward/report.json` when `.steward/` is git-ignored, otherwise the extension's storage.
Always the extension's own storage; nothing is written to the repository.
bioSteward.report.location.markdownDescription: Where the report of a check run is written.

bioSteward.diagnostics.unknownSeverity.markdownDescription: Severity in the Problems panel for results with status UNKNOWN.

bioSteward.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Seconds before a CLI run is stopped.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Keep the CLI's default: `steward check` records the checkout in its machine registry.
Run the CLI with `STEWARD_NO_REGISTRY=1`, so nothing is recorded in the registry.
bioSteward.registry.markdownDescription: Whether CLI runs from the extension record the checkout in the CLI's machine registry.

bioSteward.whereAmI.showOnReopen.markdownDescription: Show **Bio-STEWARD: Where am I?** once when a project is opened again after more than `#bioSteward.whereAmI.reopenAfterDays#` days. Turn off to show it only on request.

bioSteward.whereAmI.reopenAfterDays.markdownDescription: Days away after which reopening a project shows **Where am I?** (with `#bioSteward.whereAmI.showOnReopen#` on). The last open is kept by the extension, never in the repository.

bioSteward.tokens.claudeLogs.markdownDescription: Claude Code session logs that `steward tokens report` reads for the **Tokens** panel: absolute paths of log files or folders (a folder gives its newest `.jsonl` and `.json` files, at most 50). Usually `~/.claude/projects/<this project's folder>`. A workspace cannot set this. The CLI prints counts only; nothing leaves this machine.

bioSteward.tokens.codexLogs.markdownDescription: Codex session logs that `steward tokens report` reads for the **Tokens** panel: absolute paths of log files or folders (a folder gives its newest `.jsonl` and `.json` files, at most 50). Usually `~/.codex/sessions`. A workspace cannot set this. The CLI prints counts only; nothing leaves this machine.

bioSteward.tokens.geminiLogs.markdownDescription: Gemini CLI session logs that `steward tokens report` reads for the **Tokens** panel: absolute paths of log files or folders (a folder gives its newest `.jsonl` and `.json` files, at most 50). Usually `~/.gemini/tmp/<this project's hash>`. A workspace cannot set this. The CLI prints counts only; nothing leaves this machine.

bioSteward.notifications.toasts.markdownDescription: Show a VS Code notification toast for the three urgent notification kinds from `steward notifications`: a gate turned not eligible, an approval waits, or a sprint task failed. Turn off to see them only in the status-bar bell and Today. A workspace cannot set this.

steps.title: Initialize your project
steps.description:
Choose goals, a profile and optional Agent Skills. Review the CLI preview before confirming. Bio-STEWARD then runs the first check and opens the Overview.
[Initialize Project](command:bioSteward.initialize)
